_comment: Mobs of Mythology spawns kobold and kobold_warrior via BiomeContext.hasTag(c:badlands); the mod's Forge-side equivalent for the same field is forge:is_dry, so the intended semantics are 'dry biomes', not strictly mesa. On Fabric c:badlands is populated only by fabric-convention-tags-v1 (nested inside fabric-api) as #c:mesa + #minecraft:is_badlands, and neither Regions Unexplored nor Oh The Biomes We've Gone joins it. RU half added 2026-08-04: the 7 members of RU's own c:climate_dry tag that are also in minecraft:is_overworld (the other 5 climate_dry entries are Nether biomes and were deliberately excluded). BWG half added 2026-08-20: BWG's own #biomeswevegone:badlands (4), :desert (3) and :savanna (3) tags — BWG delegates minecraft:is_badlands to that first tag, so this follows BWG's own classification. Before the BWG half, kobolds and everything else keyed on c:badlands — Friends&Foes' badlands_mauler, and badlands structure gates in nova_structures / repurposed_structures / mtr / yungsbridges / bettermineshafts — reached zero of BWG's 10 arid biomes, i.e. none of the 50% of Overworld land BWG owns.
